newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Four feared drowned in Philippine flood.
newsitem.headline: Four feared drowned in Philippine flood.

text.p: Four construction workers were feared dead on Friday after being swept away by floods spawned by tropical storm Beth, Philippine relief officials said.
National Civil Defence headquarters said the workers were asleep in a bunkhouse in Isabela province, 330 km (205 miles) north of Manila, when their quarters were swept away.
Police rescued 16 workers and were searching for the missing four.
Residents in other low-lying areas had been evacuated to higher ground, it added.
The storm crossed the northern Philippines on Thursday night. Some parts of northern Luzon were without electricity after winds toppled power lines.
